purpose: Visible-text equivalents for meaningful BrightQuest audio cues. These do not re-enable Windows Flutter semantics.

cues.hint: A hint is available on screen.
cues.correct: Correct. Feedback and explanation are shown on screen.
cues.wrong: Try again. Guidance and the explanation are shown on screen.
cues.menuMusic: Background music only; no learning information is conveyed by music.
cues.gameMusic: Background music only; no learning information is conveyed by music.
